newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Fotex, K&H Bank to launch co-branded card.
newsitem.headline: Fotex, K&H Bank to launch co-branded card.

text.p: Hungarian retail chain Fotex and commercial bank Kereskedelmi es Hitelbank (K&H) are launching a co-branded consumer card, the first of its kind in Hungary, company and bank officials said on Wednesday.
The new Fotex Visa cards allow discounted purchases in Fotex's shops, in addition to providing traditional card services, they said.
Both K&H, which is one of the country's largest commercial banks and Fotex, Hungary's largest retail chain, believe the new business will give them an edge over competitors.

"We saw that the traditional bank card business wasn't enough in this very competitive market, that's why we decided around mid-year to launch the first co-branded card," Janos Eros, K&H Bank's managing director, told a news conference.
"We opened a new segment of the market where we would like to jointly advance within the framework of this cooperation," he said.
Fotex, which has suffered falling profits as a result of falling demand following last year's austerity measures, expects a boost in its sales from the new product.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Fotex shares closed at 98 forints, down two.
